name: Shrine Helper
body:
When you were younger, you helped care for your village’s shrine and thus spent much time in the company of the shrine’s priest.

Benefit: You gain a +1 trait bonus to Knowledge (religion) and a +2 trait bonus to Diplomacy when dealing with individuals who have Knowledge (religion) as a class skill.
